# 10X Vedic Transform

> A 48-day transformation program combining ancient Vedic wisdom with modern science across 11 daily pillars of body, mind, and spirit. Features a free Ayurvedic dosha test, daily guided practices, streak tracking, and an AI Vedic Guide.

## Key pages
- Pillars overview: https://10x.vedics.net/pillars-overview
- How it works: https://10x.vedics.net/how-it-works
- Free dosha test: https://10x.vedics.net/dosha-test
- Blog (Vedic wisdom & science): https://10x.vedics.net/blog
- FAQ: https://10x.vedics.net/faq
- About: https://10x.vedics.net/about

## The 11 pillars
Body: 5 AM Initiation (Brahma Muhurta), Vedic Nutrition + Fasting, Movement, Sleep Optimization.
Mind: Thoughts & Intention Reset (Sankalpa), Breathing + Meditation (Pranayama), Healing Meditation, Gratitude.
Spirit: Sandhya Meditation, Connection to Brahman, Divine Manifestation.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Scripture citations are paired with verifiable modern research where claims are made.
- The dosha test at /dosha-test is free and requires no signup.
